title: Zendaya Gets Ready for the Challengers Premiere | Vogue
description:
Join Zendaya as she gets ready for the Australian premiere of Luca Guadagnino's new film, Challengers. Zendaya talks about getting to play "a woman" for the first time on screen, how she cultivates her looks with stylist Law Roach, and why she's hesitant to film "getting ready with" videos.
